title: Chapter 17
content_zh: Grandmother Jia was the matriarch of the Rongguo household — the last living link to the family's glorious past. She had been a great beauty in her youth, a fearsome manager of the household in her middle age, and now, in her old age, she was the only person who could overrule the stern authority of Jia Zheng.
